home.title: Good coffee.
home.intro: Some things deserve a little more time. Discover exceptional coffees, their origins, and your next unhurried morning.

home.imageCaption: FROM THE ORIGIN. TO YOUR EVERYDAY.
home.selectionCopy: Five coffees. Four origins. Countless ways to make a moment your own.
home.philosophyCopy: In a landscape, a harvest, a pair of hands. We created Bruma to explore the character behind every coffee — and to make choosing your next cup feel as good as drinking it.
home.principle1Copy: A small, considered collection with a distinct sense of place.
home.principle2Copy: Choose your weight and preparation. Make the ritual yours.
home.principle3Copy: Thoughtful details, from the first look to the last sip.

catalog.title: Coffee with a story.
catalog.intro: From the misty highlands of Panama to the birthplace of coffee. Follow your curiosity.
catalog.emptyCopy: Try another origin or loosen your filters.

niebla.description: Delicate, floral and quietly memorable. A light-roasted Panamanian coffee with jasmine, bergamot and a lingering peach sweetness.

volcan.description: A rounded, comforting Panamanian coffee. Caramel and red fruit meet a soft cocoa finish. A little warmth for your everyday ritual.

cerrado.description: Rich and wonderfully familiar. This Brazilian coffee brings together dark chocolate, toasted almond and a smooth caramel finish.

sierra.description: Bright, balanced and generous. A Colombian coffee with orange, honey and a cocoa sweetness that makes a second cup feel inevitable.

yirgacheffe.description: A lively Ethiopian coffee with a fragrant, tea-like character. Think blueberry, lemon and a delicate floral finish.
